description: Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development - Order made to declare that all the areas of Lands comprising of Kalutara District which already declared under Gazette Notifications to be an Urban Development Area
reasoning: This gazette notification declares a specific geographical area (Kaluthara District) to be an Urban Development Area under the Urban Development Authority Law. The core content is the legal declaration of land for development purposes, including detailed metes and bounds descriptions of the area's boundaries. This falls squarely within the "Land Gazettes" category, which covers land use planning, zoning changes, and land development projects. While a government minister is named in the signing authority, the primary subject matter is land-related, not a government personnel or structural change.
